animations.name: strong kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One powerful strong kick from standing guard to full extension. Drop explosively into an acrobatic one-hand-planted kick: bend down to plant the supporting palm firmly on the ground baseline while tucking the other leg bent in mid-air and whipping the kicking leg high diagonally upward-right into the exact final pose, keeping her curly hair flowing naturally. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the ground contact anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
